categories.name: Chef
categories.description: Professional kitchen staff for restaurants and hospitality businesses.
categories.longDescription: Chefs run the kitchen — planning menus, managing preparation and maintaining quality and hygiene standards. Depending on the establishment, this may be a head chef, a sous chef or a specialised cook.

categories.name: Kitchen Helper
categories.description: Support staff for preparation, cleaning and kitchen operations.
categories.longDescription: Kitchen helpers support chefs with preparation, washing, cleaning and stocking so the kitchen runs smoothly during service.

categories.name: Waiter
categories.description: Service staff for restaurants, cafes and hospitality establishments.
categories.longDescription: Waiters take orders, serve guests and maintain the dining area. Good service staff understand timing, presentation and courteous guest interaction.

categories.name: General Helper
categories.description: Flexible support staff for day-to-day business operations.
categories.longDescription: General helpers handle loading, moving, cleaning and errands across a variety of business settings.

categories.name: Utility Staff
categories.description: Pantry, cleaning and facility support staff for offices and establishments.
categories.longDescription: Utility staff maintain pantries, common areas and basic facilities in offices and commercial establishments.

categories.name: Plumber
categories.description: Skilled plumbing staff for maintenance and facility teams.
categories.longDescription: Permanent plumbers for businesses that need in-house maintenance of water, drainage and sanitation systems.

categories.name: Carpenter
categories.description: Skilled woodwork and fit-out staff for maintenance and interiors.
categories.longDescription: Carpenters for ongoing furniture repair, fit-outs and interior maintenance in hotels, offices and commercial premises.

categories.name: Painter
categories.description: Painting and finishing staff for upkeep of business premises.
categories.longDescription: Painters for regular upkeep and refresh of walls, fixtures and exteriors in commercial and hospitality settings.

categories.name: Housekeeping Staff
categories.description: Cleaning and upkeep staff for hotels, offices and retail spaces.
categories.longDescription: Housekeeping staff keep rooms, floors and common areas clean and presentable in hotels, offices and stores.

categories.name: Security Staff
categories.description: Security personnel for premises, entrances and night shifts.
categories.longDescription: Security staff for permanent deployment at offices, stores, hotels and commercial premises.

categories.name: Office Assistant
categories.description: Administrative and front-desk support staff for offices.
categories.longDescription: Office assistants handle reception, documentation, basic coordination and administrative support.

categories.name: Other Professional & Operational Staff
categories.description: Roles that do not fit a standard category — share your requirement.
categories.longDescription: If your business needs a permanent role not listed here, describe it in your request. We will discuss scope and an indicative budget with you.
